interfaces.name: training
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty finite real rows-by-features NumPy matrix. Caller provides common feature ordering, units and preprocessing with reference. Converted to float64; large integer precision may be lost.

interfaces.name: reference
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty finite real rows-by-features NumPy matrix with training width and identical feature coordinates. Reference population must be available when selection occurs; query-driven selection is transductive.

interfaces.name: row_groups
interfaces.constraints: One integer group identifier per training row. Exact observed labels must equal group_labels. Whole groups are included without balancing; larger groups have greater empirical mass.

interfaces.name: candidates
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty boolean candidates-by-groups mask with columns in group_labels order. Every row selects at least one whole group. Duplicate candidate rows allowed and preserved. No subset generation occurs.

interfaces.name: group_labels
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty unique Python integer list defining candidate-mask column order; must exactly cover observed row_groups values.

interfaces.name: feature_columns
interfaces.constraints: Unique nonblank string list defining identical ordered features in training and reference; length equals both matrix widths. Caller must establish alignment.

interfaces.name: feature_coordinate
interfaces.constraints: Nonblank shared coordinate identifier binding upstream feature semantics and preprocessing. No inference, conversion or feature selection occurs.

interfaces.name: result
interfaces.constraints: Independent float64 candidates-by-features matrix of two-sided marginal empirical KS distances in [0,1]. Uses registered compute_ks_agreement with equal row weights. No p-values, averaging, candidate selection or tie-breaking. No guarantee of joint agreement or predictive accuracy. Witness checks shape and dimension compatibility; runtime also validates finite values and complete group membership.
